scope: TCU Business Management department redesign content provenance and migration coverage

count_definitions.fetched_url_records: The official URL request returned a source page and its HTML/text was saved; queries/languages remain distinct.
count_definitions.original_github_html_pages_available: Four HTML inputs are available from the downloaded user GitHub repository; these are design references, not official academic authorities.
count_definitions.unique_linked_document_urls: Distinct HTTP(S) links ending in PDF, DOC/DOCX, ODT, XLS/XLSX or PPT/PPTX, including original user-site resources. These links were discovered, not all downloaded.
count_definitions.discovered_internal_content_urls_not_cap: URLs discovered in captured links but not in this record set. Includes print views, other language variants, news pagination and additional content; not every entry is a substantive missing page.

history_dates.editorial_action: Do not silently blend discrepant dates; retain source links and report discrepancy.

language_variant_collision.handling: Keep full source URL including Lang query; do not merge solely by path.

legacy_graduation_requirement.legacy_claim: 128 credits, from former TCUST/Marketing and Distribution program material associated with 2019 admissions
legacy_graduation_requirement.handling: Label historical; use current entry-year curriculum documents for current/cohort-specific requirements.

conflict_notes.news_dates: Source publication dates are null where not explicitly exposed. Award years, event dates, headline dates and page-cache timestamps must not be substituted for publication dates.
conflict_notes.graduate_outcome_definition: Reported positive outcomes include employment, further study or military service; avoid presenting these as employment-only rates.
conflict_notes.source_retrieval_order: The current Chinese homepage latest announcements differ from older English achievement items; use source latest-section order and clear archived/current group labels.

scope_limits: This is a bounded source capture of major menu pages and their discoverable content links, not a claim that every external or historical page on the internet has been replicated.
English crawl captured 64 URLs and one failed URL, to depth 2. Chinese complementary crawl captured 14 URLs to depth 2; eight latest Chinese announcements were additionally captured.
English latest-update archive pages 1 and 2 were captured. Deeper archive pagination and every older news item were not exhaustively traversed.

Linked university services, social platforms, external partner sites, videos, PDFs, Office documents and other downloads retain original URLs. Their complete external contents were not all rehosted or transcribed.
Image-only pages and announcements preserve original images/posters; summaries do not constitute complete OCR transcription of every image.
Dynamic server-side search, login-only areas, and remote application workflows are outside a static migration; their official destinations remain links.
Some source URLs are aliases or duplicate content; URL counts are capture records, not counts of unique semantic pages.
Source mirror and curated route mappings describe integration targets, not a claim that this audit independently verified the final deployed output.
